options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout to Scaleway API in seconds.

options.name: api_token
options.description: Scaleway OAuth token. This is required if O(profile) is not specified.

options.name: api_url
options.description: Scaleway API URL.

options.name: container_timeout
options.description: The length of time your handler can spend processing a request before being stopped.

options.name: cpu_limit
options.description: Resources define performance characteristics of your container. They are allocated to your container at runtime. Unit is 1/1000 of a VCPU.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the container namespace.

options.name: environment_variables
options.description: Environment variables of the container namespace. Injected in container at runtime.

options.name: max_concurrency
options.description: Maximum number of connections per container. This parameter is used to trigger autoscaling.

options.name: max_scale
options.description: Maximum number of replicas for the container.

options.name: memory_limit
options.description: Resources define performance characteristics of your container. They are allocated to your container at runtime. Unit is MB of memory.

options.name: min_scale
options.description: Minimum number of replicas for the container.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the container namespace.

options.name: namespace_id
options.description: Container namespace identifier.

options.name: port
options.description: Listen port used to expose the container.

options.name: privacy
options.description: Privacy policies define whether a container can be executed anonymously. Choose V(public) to enable anonymous execution, or V(private) to protect your container with an authentication mechanism provided by the Scaleway API.

options.name: profile
options.description: The config profile in config file to load the Scaleway OAuth token from, use instead of O(api_token). It is also possible to set E(SCW_PROFILE) to use a SCW CLI config profile.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Communication protocol of the container.

options.name: query_parameters
options.description: List of parameters passed to the query string.

options.name: redeploy
options.description: Redeploy the container if update is required.

options.name: region
options.description: Scaleway region to use (for example V(fr-par)).

options.name: registry_image
options.description: The name of image used for the container.

options.name: secret_environment_variables
options.description: Secret environment variables of the container namespace. Updating those values does not output a RV(ignore:changed) state in Ansible. Injected in container at runtime.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the container.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate SSL certs of the Scaleway API.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to reach its desired state before returning.

options.name: wait_sleep_time
options.description: Time to wait before every attempt to check the state of the resource.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Time to wait for the resource to reach the expected state.
